label: early original-phase steps (t<=4), strongest on x / t / 3
explanation: Fires almost exclusively in the original (input) phase at positions t=0..4 (99.8% of mass; peak t=2, then t=1 and t=3; never after t=5, essentially silent on <DEL> and the copy phase). Within that window it is token-selective: inputs x, t and 3 have 3.5-5.8x lift and carry about 55% of mass, and the top activations (~0.4) are x or 3 at t=2. It also fires more weakly on many other tokens, mostly on first occurrences (in_first), and the rate goes up when the sequence starts with d/t/x/u/s/p, so magnitude depends on the early prefix context as well. The window alone (phase 0, t<=4) gets recall 0.996 but precision 0.13. Adding the x/t/3 token gate gives dev P=0.60 R=0.45 F1=0.51. Adding first_tok context raises mass recall to 0.77 but F1 only to 0.52. Positional window is clear; the token and context dependence is graded and only partly captured.
